entries.title: Psalms 1:1
segments: ¶Blessed [is] the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. {ungodly: or, wicked}

entries.title: Psalms 1:2
segments: But his delight [is] in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

entries.title: Psalms 1:3
segments: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. {wither: Heb. fade}

words.text: And he shall be like a tree

entries.title: Psalms 1:4
segments: ¶The ungodly [are] not so: but [are] like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

words.text: [are] not so: but [are] like the chaff

entries.title: Psalms 1:5
segments: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 1:6
segments: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
